_comment: Still image for each example on the Examples page (paths relative to content/); build.sh reads this. Examples without an entry are listed without a picture.

sod.alt: Density, velocity and pressure of the Sod shock tube against the exact solution

riemann_2d.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the 2D Riemann problem on triangles at t = 0.8

riemann_2d_quads.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the 2D Riemann problem on quadrilaterals at t = 0.8

double_mach.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the double Mach reflection at t = 0.2

wedge.alt: Pressure over the 8 degree ramp with the theoretical oblique shock

cylinder.alt: Vorticity in the wake of the cylinder at Re = 100

viscous_shock_tube.alt: Density near the floor of the viscous shock tube at t = 1 and wall density against the reference

explosion_3d.alt: Density of every cell of the 3D spherical explosion against radius, on a 1D reference

mallard.alt: Mach number of Mach 8 flow over a flying mallard at t = 0.75

taylor_green_3d.alt: Q-criterion isosurfaces of the Taylor-Green vortex and its dissipation rate against the spectral DNS

sphere_mach3.alt: Mach 3 flow over a sphere with the bow-shock standoff against Billig's correlation

sedov_3d.alt: Sedov-Taylor blast wave on three symmetry planes with the shock radius against the similarity solution

shu_osher.alt: Density of the Shu-Osher problem against a fine-grid reference

sphere_re300.alt: Hairpin vortices shed by a sphere at Re = 300

h2_ignition.alt: Temperature history of constant-volume H2/air ignition and ignition delays of H2/air and CH4/air against Cantera

reactive_shock_tube.alt: Temperature and pressure of the reactive shock tube at 170 and 230 microseconds on three meshes

detonation_1d.alt: Front speed of the 1D CJ detonation against the CJ speed, and pressure behind the front against the ZND profile

detonation_2d.alt: Numerical soot foil of the 2D cellular detonation

flame_2d.alt: Temperature of the lean hydrogen flame with mixture-averaged and unity Lewis number transport

premixed_flame.alt: Flame speeds of H2/air flames against Cantera

isotropic_turbulence.alt: Q-criterion isosurfaces of decaying compressible isotropic turbulence colored by dilatation, with enstrophy and dilatation variance against Johnsen et al.

counterflow_diffusion.alt: Peak temperature of the counterflow diffusion flame against strain rate, Mallard against Cantera

triple_flame.alt: Heat release of triple flames in hydrogen/air mixing layers of two thicknesses, with their propagation speed

flame_vortex.alt: Temperature of eleven premixed flame-vortex interactions on the spectral diagram of Poinsot, Veynante and Candel

channel_retau180.alt: Near-wall vortices and velocity streaks of turbulent channel flow at Re_tau = 180

shock_bubble_3d.alt: Vortex ring of a shock-accelerated helium bubble with schlieren and interface positions

detonation_3d.alt: Leading shock of a 3D cellular detonation and the numerical soot foils of the duct walls

autoignition_2d.alt: Temperature and heat release of four stratified autoignition runs
